name: Shared memory corpus (read-only)
description: Lets memory_search (corpus=all) and memory_get read the coding agents' shared Markdown memory, in direct chats only; never writes.

root.label: Store root
root.help: Directory of the shared Markdown memory (default ~/.shared-memory).

includeArchive.label: Include archive
includeArchive.help: Also search archive/ topics, ranked lower (default true).
